working_definition: Visceral muscle cells of the crop from the gut analysis (Li et al. 2022; Manual Annotation, broad class muscle cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell that is part of the circular muscle fibers of the adult crop. In the stalk, it consists of wide bands 1.5um thick and 3-7um wide. In the sac, thick muscle fibers extend around the base of each lobe, converging posteriorly, and the distended portions of the wall are covered with a plexus of branched and interlacing fibers 1-3um thick.

justification: FBbt only has adult crop circular muscle cell (a child of foregut muscle cell and adult visceral muscle cell); no term covers all crop visceral muscle. Foregut muscle cell is the most specific true parent of crop muscle cells (the crop is adult-only, so the non-adult-specific parent is acceptable).
